Hi Alex — Camila from the infra team here. Quick clarifying Qs before we spin up a repro: 

1) Is the payload you attached the exact body you send to /v1/rerank (including any structured_output/tool_call instructions)?
2) Are you using streaming responses or a single blocking call?
3) Can you confirm the average document length for the candidate set (we need to know approximate token counts per candidate).

A couple quick mitigation suggestions you can try immediately: 
- Increase client-side timeout to 60s and enable exponential backoff (3 retries) — Node SDK has client options for this.
- If you are sending structured_output or tool-calling instructions with the reranker, try removing them as a test to see if that changes behavior.
- Try reducing batch size from 16 -> 8 to see if failure rate drops.

cURL repro snippet you can try while we look: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"

Hi Alex — Neha (platform reliability) here. We were able to reproduce a similar 5xx in a staging repro using your payload and Node SDK behavior. Preliminary findings:

- Root cause appears to be a combination of: large per-candidate token counts (~350 tokens) + batching 16 items -> request processing occasionally exceeds the default 30s worker timeout under load.
- We also saw increased memory pressure when structured_output was included alongside large candidate sets (structured_output adds an internal validation pass).

Short-term mitigations we recommend you try immediately: 
1) Reduce batch size to 8 and increase client timeout to 60s.
2) Disable structured_output for the reranker request as a test (or move structured parsing to a subsequent lightweight call).
3) Enable client-side retries with exponential backoff (start with 3 attempts).

We've opened INF-7892 to track the server-side tuning (worker timeout bump and memory guardrails). We'll push a small SDK patch to Node SDK (v1.4.3) with a friendly default timeout and a clear error when structured_output + large batches are used. ETA for SDK patch: 48–72 hours.

Can you confirm when you can test the reduced batch/timeout and whether you prefer a joint debug session?

Thanks — Neha
